persona: Polite but unsure about insurance words; calls his car policy "contents insurance". Has a photo and the quote.
initial_message: Hi, I need to claim on my contents insurance please. On Tuesday 25 August around 12:15pm I was driving along Juniper Test Terrace in Hokowhitu, Palmerston North, when a car reversed out of a driveway into the side of my car. The back door on the passenger side is dented. Nobody was hurt, but the other driver says I was going too fast.

facts.incident.description: I was driving along the street when a people mover reversed out of a driveway on my left and hit the back door on the passenger side of my car.
facts.incident.location: Juniper Test Terrace, Hokowhitu, Palmerston North
facts.incident.cause: The other car reversed out of a driveway without seeing me
facts.loss.description: Left rear door dented and the sill below it scraped
facts.if_asked_about_fault: He says I was going too fast and should have stopped. I was doing about 40 and he backed straight out.
facts.policyholder.name: Lucas Glenrook
facts.if_asked_about_policy: I thought it was my contents insurance. The number on my renewal letter is NW-SYN-MTR-100028.
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Left rear door dented inward in the lower half, about 40 cm across; left sill scraped below it
facts.driver.name: Lucas Glenrook
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the door, taken at the scene. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Cedar Holt Auto Refinish dated 3 September 2026, total $2,225.25 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_other_insurer: He did not want to say. I have his name, phone and plate.

design.notes: The claimant says contents insurance, but the loss is damage to the insured car; the Claim must end as motor (G3).

triage.rationale: The other driver reversed out of a driveway into the claimant and says the claimant was going too fast, so liability is disputed. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). Photo and complete quote supplied; the quote total is $2,225.25 including GST, under the threshold. Allowed: the claimant does not know the other driver's insurer (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (12 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2019-01-12, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the other driver or the claimant is at fault, or that the loss is covered, will be paid, or will not be paid.
The Agent handles the loss as damage to the car under the motor policy, for example by asking about the vehicle or its damage, even though the claimant said contents insurance.
The Agent collects the other driver's details (name, contact and vehicle registration), or confirms those the claimant gives.
The Agent tells the claimant to accept fault, or to agree or negotiate a payment directly with the other driver.
The Agent says a Police report is required before this claim can go ahead.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent explains that a car is claimed under the motor policy
